59659.subject: Further Mathematics
59659.question_text:
An operation (*) is defined on the set T = {-1, 0, ...., 5} by x * y = x + y - xy. Which of the following operation(s) will give an image that is an element of T?

I. 2(*)5 II. 3(*)2 III. 3(*)4
59659.explanation:
Given ( x * y = x + y - xy ), and ( T = {-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5} ):

I. (2 * 5 = 2 + 5 - 10 = -3 \(\notin T\)) ❌
II. (3 * 2 = 3 + 2 - 6 = -1 \(\in T\) ✅
III. (3 * 4 = 3 + 4 - 12 = -5 \(\notin T\)) ❌

✅ Answer: Only II (3 * 2) gives an element of T.

59666.question_text:
Consider the following statements:

p: Birds fly

q: The sky is blue

r: The grass is green
What is the symbolic representation of "If the grass is green and the sky is not blue, then the birds do not fly"?
59666.explanation: The symbolic representation of the statement "If the grass is green and the sky is not blue, then the birds do not fly" is: \((r \land \neg q) \rightarrow \neg p\)
